scope: finite numerical diagnostic, no Cn theorem
crosscheck: each chunk one of five s values rotating, h/r=2^-80, rho/r=2^256, eps factor 1/2; direct source integral and one-sided derivatives at kink and perturbations 2^-192; baseline mean and second moment/variance
threshold: quadrature scaled error <1e-80; derivative scaled error <1e-25; baseline mean error <1e-100
stop: pilot failure blocks production; in production exception or numerical disagreement stops affected chunk and records exact point; finite counts otherwise
